''See also: [[Benson Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Benson is a [[steel skeleton]] who resides in the blue-lit basement of [[Valinhall]]. He possesses a physical form made entirely of shining silver metal and features eyes that glow with [[sapphire]] flames. Typically seen lounging on a rough-hewn [[stone]] [[throne]] while wearing a tattered, wide-brimmed hat, he is often accompanied by [[Borus]] and various [[suits of armor]] that can animate to fight. Benson is a formidable combatant capable of wielding massive, double-bladed battle-axes with ease in a single hand. He also serves as a savior to certain individuals, providing them with his [[steel]] to grant them enhanced strength, resilience, and defense. This [[steel]] can be mentally summoned by users to protect their bodies or increase their physical capabilities, though it is a finite resource. Benson appears to act as a mentor or tester for those who utilize his [[steel]], engaging them in combat to gauge their abilities.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Benson is a [[skeleton]] composed of shining silvery metal. His eyes glow with a [[sapphire]] flame, including one eye that blazes blue.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Benson wields a massive double-bladed axe. He is also associated with the provision of [[steel]] and once gave [[Kai]] a quicksilver vial.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|City of Light}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Benson is cited as a possible instance of a guardian transforming into an artificial [[construct]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c8">''City of Light'', chapter 8</ref> During a confrontation with [[Erastes]] in the basement, Benson appears as a [[skeleton]] composed of shining silvery metal.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c14">''City of Light'', chapter 14</ref> This [[steel skeleton]] fights while wielding an axe.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c14" /> Ultimately, [[Kai]] managed to take power from Benson.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22">''City of Light'', chapter 22</ref>}}
